---
title: "MXB362 Case Study — AADT-Weighted Human Pressure Surface"
author: "Nicola McIlear (n11798661)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyterra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)
library(scales)

checkpoint_dir <- "checkpoints"
utm_crs <- 32611

aadt_utm       <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "aadt_utm.rds"))
ndvi_stack_utm <- rast(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "ndvi_stack_utm.tif"))
names(aadt_utm)                                       # confirm the AADT column name
```

## Coarsened grid and nearest-highway lookup

```{r pressure-grid}
template <- ndvi_stack_utm[[1]]
coarse_template <- aggregate(template, fact = 4)       # ~1km cells, for tractability

grid_pts <- as.points(coarse_template) %>% st_as_sf()
st_crs(grid_pts) <- utm_crs

nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(grid_pts, aadt_utm)
grid_pts$aadt <- aadt_utm$AADT[nearest_idx]             # nearest state-highway AADT value
grid_pts$dist_to_highway <- st_distance(grid_pts, aadt_utm[nearest_idx, ], by_element = TRUE) %>%
  as.numeric()

summary(grid_pts$aadt)
summary(grid_pts$dist_to_highway)
```

## Pressure score and raster

```{r pressure-raster}
grid_pts$pressure <- grid_pts$aadt / (1 + grid_pts$dist_to_highway)^2  # inverse-distance decay

pressure_raster <- rasterize(vect(grid_pts), coarse_template, field = "pressure")
names(pressure_raster) <- "human_pressure"
```

## Plot

```{r pressure-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = pressure_raster) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#ffffcc", "#fd8d3c", "#bd0026"),
    na.value = NA, name = "Human\npressure\n(AADT-weighted)",
    trans = "log1p", breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 1000), labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25) +
  labs(
    title = "AADT-weighted human pressure surface",
    subtitle = "Exploratory — coverage limited to areas near state highways",
    caption = "Pressure = AADT / (1 + distance to nearest highway)\u00b2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
```
